operator: hostapd 2.11 and Firmware/ap_frame_test.py in an OrbStack Ubuntu VM; Location Services-enabled CoreWLAN scan from macOS

console.model_source: owner manual confirmation; PTP DeviceInfo reports the generic model 'Nintendo Switch'
console.firmware_observation_note: The console was not involved in this control test.
console.modification_source: owner report; this test does not detect modifications

commands.command: sudo ip link set <interface> down; sudo iw dev <interface> set type managed; sudo ip link set <interface> up
commands.result: The adapter was switched from monitor mode to managed mode.
hostapd reached 'AP-ENABLED' on channel 1 with SSID TX10LED-TEST. It was stopped by the wrapper after the injection window.
Twenty beacon frames were submitted through NL80211_CMD_FRAME. Each request returned without a netlink error and the script logged 'sent 1/20' through 'sent 20/20'.

commands.command: LocationScan.app: CoreWLAN scanForNetworks(withSSID: nil), 12 scans at one-second intervals
commands.result: All 12 scans reported both TX10LED-APINJ and TX10LED-TEST at -28 dBm on channel 1 with the host adapter BSSID. Ambient networks on channels 1, 6, 11, 36, and 100 were also visible.

commands.command: sudo pkill -x hostapd; restore monitor mode on channel 1
commands.result: hostapd stopped and the adapter was restored to monitor mode on channel 1. The wrapper's cleanup trap completed.

injection_test.receiver: macOS CoreWLAN wildcard scan with Location Services authorization

interpretation: The adapter, the in-kernel rtw88_8822bu driver, and mac80211 can put a beacon submitted through NL80211_CMD_FRAME on an AP interface on the air. The Mac received the injected TX10LED-APINJ beacon at -28 dBm with the adapter BSSID in all 12 scans, alongside the hostapd beacon TX10LED-TEST. This removes the AP-mode beacon half of the injection question. It does not show that a vendor action frame can be sent: E-093 records that a non-public action frame on an AP interface needs a station entry, so a broadcast LDN vendor action frame is rejected before it reaches the driver.
authorization: The owner approved a harmless AP-mode beacon test on channel 1 with a test SSID. The test did not touch the console and did not send LDN frames or vendor action frames.
limitations: One adapter, one driver, one kernel, and one channel.
The test transmitted beacon frames, not LDN beacons or vendor action frames.
The Mac scan is a reception check, not a frame capture.
The AP-mode interface requires hostapd or an equivalent AP setup; the test used hostapd on channel 1.
The host adapter BSSID and interface name are redacted.
redactions: Interface name redacted because it is derived from the adapter MAC.
